title: Tracehook investigation scratchbook
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal scratchpad for the intermittent trace hook failures + downstream metric holes observed starting ~2026-02-25. Aim is to capture commands I ran, raw error snippets, and short hypotheses so I (or next person) can pick up work quickly. Not exhaustive; fast notes.

Symptom summary (high level):
- ~30% of traces for requests routed through the EU cluster are missing the app-level span (service=redwood-api) but have infra spans (nginx, k8s).
- Metrics for related API route (route: /v1/generate) show a drop in per-route RT histogram and token-level counters between 12:00-14:30 UTC on a few days.
- Logs show "otel: span sampler error: failed to export" in the obs-forwarder logs around same windows.

First-observed incidents (notes):
- 2026-02-25 12:14 UTC: spike in missing traces for eu-west-1; support ticket from partner A.
- 2026-02-27 13:05 UTC: smaller spike correlated with rollout of obs-forwarder v1.3.7 to dedicated nodes.
- 2026-03-08 13:20 UTC: similar pattern but only on nodes with affinity label "dedicated-gpu-spot".

Commands I ran (local / on prod-ish clusters):
- tail logs from obs-forwarder pod:
  kubectl -n infra logs obs-forwarder-5b7d -c forwarder --since=3h | grep -E "sampler|export|error"

- sample trace bundle request captured from nginx-ingress: (saved to /tmp/trace-sample.json)
  curl -s -X POST "https://ingest-eu.internal/trace" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @/tmp/trace-sample.json | jq '.' | less

- check OTEL env for forwarder pod:
  kubectl -n infra exec -it obs-forwarder-5b7d -- env | egrep "OTEL|EXPORTER|SAMPLER"

- confirm exporter connectivity to agent sink (quick netcat):
  kubectl -n infra exec obs-forwarder-5b7d -- /bin/sh -c 'echo | nc -v -w 3 sink-observability:4317'

Raw error snippets found in forwarder logs:
- "2026-03-08T13:22:05Z ERROR sampler: failed to export span batch: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed"
- "2026-02-27T13:06:12Z WARN telemetry: exporter closed unexpectedly, retrying"
- "otel: sampler returned error: invalid sample decision (nil)"
- "panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
  goroutine 112 [running]:
  github.com/redwood-inference/obs/forwarder.(*Sampler).Decide(0x0, 0xc0000a5f00)"

Quick hypothesis list (ranked by plausibility):
1) Forwarder goroutine nil deref: regression in v1.3.7 introduced a path where Sampler pointer may be uninitialized when hot-reloading config; causes occasional crash or no-op sampling resulting in traces missing app spans. Explains stack traces and correlation with rollout.
2) Intermittent connection drops between forwarder and agent sink (4317) during autoscaler churn -> exporter errors -> spans buffered and eventually dropped due to buffer limits. Explains exporter Unavailable messages and metric drop windows.
3) Config mismatch: OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY unset on some nodes (env injection bug), defaulting to 0 => no app spans sampled. This would explain whole-node patterns (dedicated-gpu-spot affinity).
4) Backpressure from KV cache layer in serving-runtime causing request path to return before app spans are emitted (less likely because infra spans are still visible).

Observations that support or refute hypotheses:
- v1.3.7 rollout correlates with first reproductions; v1.3.6 clusters do not show nil pointer traces -> supports (1).
- netcat checks show occasional connection timeouts on nodes with high CPU steal -> supports (2) but not sufficient.
- env dumps from 3 affected pods: OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY absent in 2/3 pods, present in unaffected pods -> supports (3).
- replayed sample trace through forwarder in staging (with instrumentation) reproduced missing app span when sampler env missing -> stronger support for (3).

Quick reproduction steps (staging):
1) deploy obs-forwarder:v1.3.7 to staging with OTEL env removed from configmap.
2) send 100 synthetic requests through ingress with header x-debug-trace:1
3) check traces in dev-trace-collector for presence of service=redwood-api spans. Expect ~0% for bad config, ~100% for correct config.

Temporary mitigations attempted:
- Rolled back obs-forwarder to v1.3.6 in a canary pool; trace completeness returned to baseline.
- Added liveness/readiness probe to forwarder to restart on nil-deref panic -> mitigate but not fix root cause.
- Added a temporary init container check that asserts OTEL_* env vars are present (fast-fail config injection).

Longer-term fixes to propose:
- Fix upstream: ensure Sampler is instantiated before hot-config reload paths; add unit test that simulates config hot reload with nil sampler. (PR available: linked above)
- Harden exporter: exponential backoff + circuit-breaker + persistent local queue to avoid dropping spans on transient sink failures.
- CI: add an integration test that deploys forwarder with missing OTEL env to catch mis-injection earlier.
- Ops: modify rollout playbook to include smoke traces check (2-3 synthetic requests and verify service spans) before promoting to larger pools.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who owns the configmap injection? Need to loop in infra-k8s (Samir?) to trace the templating path that omitted OTEL vars.
- Is there an upstream upgrade to the exporter library that addresses connection handling? (Liang to check vendor changelog)
- Should we backfill traces for partner A to help debugging? Costs vs benefit — discuss with CS.

Notes for next investigator (quick):
- Look in obs-forwarder pod logs for sampler/errors around incident windows. Use grep for "sampler" and "export" keywords.
- Check node metrics (cpu steal, network drops) for affected time windows; correlate with autoscaler events (k8s events).
- Useful kubectl snippets are included above; sample traces saved at /tmp/trace-sample.json in my laptop if you ask (not checked in).

Appendix: small checklist to run on suspect pool
- kubectl get pods -l app=obs-forwarder -o wide
- for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=obs-forwarder -o name); do kubectl exec -n infra $pod -- env | grep OTEL || echo "$pod missing OTEL"; done
- kubectl -n infra logs -l app=obs-forwarder --since=2h | grep -E "panic|sampler|export|Unavailable"
- Run 50 synthetic requests with header x-debug-trace and inspect traces in dev-collector (filter by traceid)

End of scratchbook.
